schema.description: The "Other" window: the outputs of the other steps of the map, grouped by step (1.x `DisponiblesVue[]`).

AnchorBody.description: The insertion of a block in the flow (1.x `AncreDemande`: `etape_id`, `position`: `before` or `after`).

Arrangement.description: What "Finish" stored: kind, object, name, arrival step (null: the map, or nothing for a deleted document or a dropped usage).

AssignBody.description:
`POST /api/dissolutions/{id}/assign` (1.x `AffectationDemande`: `genre`, `objet_id`, `etape_id`, `depuis_etape_id`):
the kind of the element (`document`, `usage`, `pain_point`), the element, the step of arrival (null: the map, for a
pain point; the dissolved step: back to the remainder) and the step that holds it when it comes back.

AssistantAskBody.description:
`POST /api/maps/{id}/assistant/exchanges` and its kin: the practice of the tile (`free` without one), the request, the
codes of the steps selected, the former turns of the panel, the files joined to the request, and the language of a
translation (practice `translate`, ADR 083).

AssistantCostView.description:
The tokens of an exchange, and its cost estimated at the public prices of the API of Anthropic (null for another
connector or an unknown model), shown to the administrator only (spec 3.0 section 3.4).

AssistantDestinationView.description:
Where the data of an exchange go (spec 3.0 section 6: the panel says it in one line): the connector, its model and
region, the classification of the project, the scope and its map.

AssistantEvent.description:
A line of the stream of an exchange (`application/x-ndjson`): `started` with where the data go, `progress` with the
phase, the last thought of the model, the characters written and the time, then one `reply` or one `failure`.

AssistantFaultView.description:
A fault of the `.pmap` of a proposal, as the opening of a file reports it (A-1.2-19): its place in the file and its code;
the host writes the message in the language of the person from the values of the fault.

AssistantFileBody.description: A file joined to a request (lot 4): its name and its content in base64, kept by the page for the conversation.

AssistantFileBoundsView.description:
The bounds of the files as the panel checks them before sending (the host checks them again): the most files of a
conversation, the largest file, image and whole, in bytes; the extensions admitted, and the former formats with the one
to save them as.

AssistantFindingView.description: A finding of an analysis: its kind, title and detail, the codes of the objects in question, the suggestion of the model.

AssistantObjectView.description:
An object of the project named by a reply, by its code: a step or a lane, the map it lives on, its identifier; the panel
selects it and shows it on its map when the code is clicked.

AssistantPasteBody.description:
`POST /api/maps/{id}/assistant/replies`: the exchange as for a model, and the reply pasted from the AI of the person;
its files are not read again (the person joined them in their AI).

AssistantPastedView.description: The reply pasted as the panel shows it, or the reason it cannot be read.

AssistantPromptView.description: The whole prompt of an exchange, to copy into the AI of the person.

AssistantProposalView.description:
The proposal of the model (spec 3.0 section 7): the `.pmap` 1.1 of the state wanted, what it holds, the points it asks a
person to check, and the faults that made the format refuse it after the correction asked (empty when it opens).

AssistantQuestionView.description: A question of the model, with the choices it offers (none for a free answer).

AssistantReplyView.description:
A reply as the panel shows it, of one of the four forms: the message of the model (the answer, or the words that open
its questions, findings or proposal), its questions, findings or proposal, the objects of the project it names; the
JSON it wrote, that the page gives back with the next turns; its cost for the administrator; its time.

AssistantSettingsBody.description:
`PUT /api/admin/assistant` and `POST /api/admin/assistant/test` (new in 3.0): the connector of the list, its model,
region and AWS profile, the ceiling of a reply, the classifications that may be sent; the secret null keeps the one
kept, an empty secret removes it, any other text replaces it. It is written, never read back.

AssistantSettingsView.description:
The settings as the dialog shows them: never the secret, only whether one is kept and its last characters; the codes
of the connectors of the list and of the classifications.

AssistantStatusView.description:
The state of the assistant for a map, read when the panel opens: a model to call or the copy and paste (the connector
None or Copier-coller), whether the classification of the project may be sent, what the person may ask of it (a
proposal needs the facilitator), whether the map is empty (the tiles then offer to create), and the selection
admitted.

AssistantTestOutcome.description:
The account of a test of the connection: the model that answered and the time it took, the tokens of the exchange; or
the reason it failed, as a code the interface names (AssistantFailures) and a detail of the provider
without any secret.

AssistantTurnBody.description: A former turn of the panel, kept by the page: the request of the person, the JSON the model replied, the files joined to the request.

AuditEntry.description: One event of the audit trail as an administrator reads it: identifiers, kind, time, details (spec 5.5).

AvailableOutput.description: An output of the "Other" window, with the marker of a document the step already uses.

AvailableOutputs.description: The outputs of one step of the map, for the "Other" window.

BreadcrumbView.description: A map of the breadcrumb, from the root map down to the map read (1.x `ArianeVue`), with the language its name was entered in.

Cell.description: A cell of a map grid. Columns run from 0 to 10 000, rows (parallel branches of an actor) from 0 to 50.

ChangeProfileBody.description:
`PATCH /api/me` (1.x: `langue`, `nom_affiche`, `premiere_visite_faite`): only the fields present change. A language or
a display name sent as null is refused like an empty one (LANGUE_INVALIDE, CHAMP_OBLIGATOIRE), as the 1.x did.

ClassificationBody.description:
`PUT /api/projects/{id}/classification` (spec 4.1, route named by the host): the code of the level, required (spec 5.4:
an absent field is an error, never the default of the creation).

CodeState.description: Whether the code a package would take is free, the code of a live project, or of a project in the trash.

CreatedProject.description: A project just created: what the reply 201 and its `Location` name, and the users invited with it.

DeleteSelectionBody.description:
`POST /api/maps/{id}/deletion` (1.x `SuppressionDemande`: `etapes`, `liens`, `recoudre`, `sous_cartes=supprimer`):
the steps and flows deleted in one batch, `stitch`, and `sub_maps` = `delete` for the filled sub-maps.

Document.description: A document produced by a step (output) or received from outside the map (input), annex A 2.11.

DocumentBody.description:
`POST /api/steps/{id}/documents` and `PUT .../documents/{documentId}` (1.x `DocumentDemande`: `sens`, `libelle`,
`adresse`, `attente_heures`, `partage_confirme`), named as the fields of the refusals of the domain.

DocumentMarker.description: A document marker of a step: its name and its direction (input for a document received from another step).

DocumentUse.description: A step uses the output of another step (ticked), with waiting time, %C&A and pain point; versioned (D06).

DocumentUseBody.description:
`PUT /api/steps/{id}/uses/{documentId}` (1.x `UsageDemande`: `attente_heures`, `pct_ca`, `irritant`,
`temps_perdu_h_mois`), named as the fields of the refusals of the domain.

DuplicateProjectBody.description: `POST /api/projects/{id}/duplicate`: the code and the name of the copy, those of the source when absent (A-1.2-21).

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error of the API: the stable code, the message in the language of the user, the values.

ExecutionBasis.description: How the executions of a step in a month are counted (spec 14.3, 6).

ExportPackageBody.description:
`POST /api/projects/{id}/export`: `without_people` is required (spec 5.4: an absent field is an error, never a
silent default); the interface checks it by default (AR-34).

FigureOrigin.description: Where the work or the lead time of a step comes from.

FinishReply.description:
The reply of « finish »: the fields of StructureReply (`id` is the dissolution) and the `arrangements`
that the 1.x returned alone (`Rangement`: kind, object, name, step of arrival), none for a frame already closed.

FlowShare.description: The effective share of a flow, from 0 to 1, or null when unknown.

FlowTranslationsBody.description: `PUT /api/flows/{id}/translations` (new in 2.0): the label by language, a null text deletes the translation.

share_percent.description: The share of the cases of an exit of a decision or an inclusive gateway, in percent (spec 14.2, S2).

FlowView.description: A flow with the names of the documents it carries (outputs of the source used by the target).

FrameReply.description:
The reply of « assign » and « remove »: the fields of StructureReply (`id` is the dissolution) and the
`frame` that the 1.x returned alone (`RemonteeVue`): the open frame of the map with its remainder, null once closed.

FrameView.description:
A frame and its remainder. The sheet of the dissolved step is read only and is exposed by its identifier: what a
reader may see of it is decided by `SheetVisibility` (spec 5.6 point 1).

FrequencySuggestion.description: A frequency taken from another step, with its code.

HealthReply.description: The health (1.x `EtatSante` without `ia`): `ok` or `degraded`, the database `ok` or `unavailable`, the version, the time.

HealthStatusReply.description: The health given to an anonymous caller of the server mode: the state alone (spec 5.3, weakness 1.x 5.6-8).

HistoryItem.description: An operation of the history: the chain, its kind and when its latest entry was written.

HistoryView.description: What the user can undo and redo on a map, the next one first (annex B 2.6: it survives a reload).

IgnoredRow.description: A row left aside, with its reason (one of IgnoredRowReasons).

ImportedProject.description: A project imported: what the reply 201 and its `Location` name, the code given to a replaced project, the users created.

ImportPreview.description:
The preview of an import (spec 7.3): the code of the package and the code the project would take, whether it is free,
whether the package holds the people, what it holds, the logins it names that nobody has here, the members the project
would have, what the import would settle and, for a replacement, the code the replaced project would take in the trash.

ImportSettlement.description: What the settling of an imported project changed: the importer added as a member, the holders released.

LaneStream.description: The headcount and the workload of a lane (spec 14.3, 16); the workload is complete when no step of the lane lacks it.

headcount.description: The headcount of a lane of people (spec 14.2, S4).

LastProjectBody.description: `PUT /api/me/last-project` (AR-49, route named by the host): the project the user has just opened.

LayoutBody.description:
`PUT /api/maps/{id}/layout` (1.x `DispositionDemande`: `ordre_couloirs`, `etapes`), with `purpose` (`move` by default,
`align` for the Align wand), which names the operation in the log as the 1.x client did.

MainPath.description:
The main path (spec 14.3, 12): its steps from an entry to an end, the segments of its steps with content, and its totals,
complete when no segment lacks its value. The ratio is the work over the lead time, both in working hours.

MapReply.description: The read of a map: the map and what the reader can undo and redo on it (annex B 2.6: it survives a reload).

MapRightsView.description: What the viewer may do on the map: change its structure (facilitator), and the role he acts with.

MapStream.description:
The value stream of a map: the work time it was computed with, its steps, flows and lanes, its main path, the totals
of the map and its detailed maps, and the completeness check of the same scope, in order.

value_stream.description:
The value stream of the map and its detailed maps (ADR 085), computed by the core at every reading with the sheets as
the viewer sees them: the figures of its steps, flows and lanes, the main path, the totals and the completeness check.

stream_subjects.description: The objects named by the completeness check of MapStream MapView.ValueStream, by identifier of the step, lane or map.

MapView.description:
The whole map as the 1.x `GET /api/cartes/{id}` returned it (annex A 2.4), with integer versions (D06) and the structure
version of the project, so that the client knows whether its map is up to date (spec 4.7), and the languages of the
project (ADR 083).

MemberBody.description: A member entered in a list (1.x `MembreDemande`: `login`, `role`, `est_sponsor`).

MembersReply.description: The members after a replacement, in display order, the users invited and created with them, and the people who left.

MemberView.description: A member as the replies show him (1.x `MembreVue`).

MoveStepsBody.description: `POST /api/maps/{id}/move` (no 1.x route, AR-44): the dragged steps and their cells, one operation.

OpenPmapBody.description:
`POST /api/projects/import-pmap`: the file as a text in the JSON body (A-4-54), the code and the name entered at the
opening, and, for a proposal of the assistant, its map of origin, whose steps carry their sheets and translations (ADR 082).

OptionalOfGuid.description:
A field of a PATCH body: absent (nothing changes), or present with its value, null included (the value is removed).
The 1.x told both apart by reading the JSON by hand; here the converter is called only for a field present in the
body, so an absent field keeps the default, not present.

OptionalOfint.description:
A field of a PATCH body: absent (nothing changes), or present with its value, null included (the value is removed).
The 1.x told both apart by reading the JSON by hand; here the converter is called only for a field present in the
body, so an absent field keeps the default, not present.

OptionalOfstring.description:
A field of a PATCH body: absent (nothing changes), or present with its value, null included (the value is removed).
The 1.x told both apart by reading the JSON by hand; here the converter is called only for a field present in the
body, so an absent field keeps the default, not present.

OptionalOfVolumeBody.description:
A field of a PATCH body: absent (nothing changes), or present with its value, null included (the value is removed).
The 1.x told both apart by reading the JSON by hand; here the converter is called only for a field present in the
body, so an absent field keeps the default, not present.

PackageCounts.description: What a package holds, counted for the preview (spec 7.3).

PainPoint.description: A pain point raised on the producing step, or on the map when StepId is null (annex A 2.12).

PainPointMarker.description: A pain point marker of a step: a pain point not yet dealt with.

PastedFlowBody.description: A flow of a pasted copy, between two keys of the paste (1.x `LienColle`: `source`, `cible`, `libelle`).

PastedStepBody.description: A step of a pasted copy (1.x `EtapeCollee`: `cle`, `libelle`, `type`, `couloir_id`, `colonne`, `rangee`).

PathSegment.description: A step of the main path with its lead time and its work by case, null when unknown.

PmapOpened.description:
A project opened from a file or duplicated (reply 201): what the 1.x returned, the sheets written as drafts besides;
whether a duplication left sub-maps out beyond the walks of the domain, said by the header of the route, not the body.

ProcedureLineBody.description: A line of the procedure as entered (1.x `Operation`: `texte`, `outil`, `nature`).

ProcedureTask.description: A cleaned micro-task of the procedure.

desktop.description:
The host runs in desktop mode (spec 5.2, 6.1): one user, administrator of his data file; the interface offers the
command « Quit » and, while he has no project, the sample project. Set by the host, which alone knows its mode.

ProfileView.description:
The profile (1.x `ProfilVue`): the language of the profile and the effective one (AR-51), the administrator flag, the
first visit, the last project opened (AR-49), the version (AR-07), the roles in the live projects, and the languages of
the configuration in their order, from which the interface builds its language switch (AR-29, NF12, ADR 057).

workday_hours.description: The working day, in hours (spec 14.2, S6).

fte_hours_per_month.description: The hours of a full-time equivalent in a month (spec 14.2, S6).

ProjectDetail.description: The detail of a project (1.x `ProjetDetail`), with its members in display order and its version.

ProjectLanguagesView.description:
The languages of the project (ADR 083): its language of origin, in which every text is created and which alone may
change the structure, the number of its texts, and for each language the number written in it (original or
translation), from which the client shows how far each language is translated.

ProjectListItem.description:
A live project of the home page (1.x `ProjetResume`): the role is the effective one, facilitator for an administrator;
its classification, shown on its card (spec 4.1).

ProjectRole.description: The role of a user in one live project, as the profile shows it (`GET /api/me`, 1.x `RoleProjet`).

ProposalBody.description:
`POST /api/maps/{id}/assistant/preview` and `/apply`: the text of the `.pmap` proposed, and for a translation by the
assistant its language (ADR 083: only the translations into it are taken).

ProposalChangeView.description: A change of the preview as the panel lists it: kind, code, text, what becomes of it, the fields changed.

ProposalLossView.description: A step of the scope that a new project would not carry: its code, label, whether it is detailed and has a sheet.

translations.description: The texts a translation writes, in the order of the maps; empty for any other proposal.

ProposalPreviewView.description:
The preview of a proposal on the map open: its changes, their counts by kind and action, its warnings, and the structure
version of the project it was computed on, which « Appliquer » gives back (If-Match). Its mode (ADR 082): `in_place`, or
`new_project` when it brings steps up a level or moves them (its reasons, `raised:CODE`, `moved:CODE`), with the steps of
the scope it would not carry; such a proposal is only opened as a new project. A translation (ADR 083) also gives the
texts it writes, which the map shows in place before anything is written.

ProposalTranslatedView.description:
A text a translation by the assistant writes (ADR 083): its kind (`project`, `lane`, `step`, `flow`), identifier, code,
text of origin and translation; `kept` for a translation typed by hand that stays, its own text given.

ProposedInput.description:
An input of the sheet. Producer null: external input. Near: produced by a step linked by an incoming flow (offered
unticked); otherwise added through "Other". Use: the tick of the step, if any.

RaciView.description: A visible RACI role of a step on a lane (the responsible lane R is the lane of the step and is not listed).

ReattachBody.description: `POST /api/maps/{id}/reattach` (1.x `RattachementDemande`): the step that receives the sub-map.

RecordKey.description: Identity of a record inside a project workspace: its type and its key values.

RelabelFlowBody.description: `PATCH /api/flows/{id}` (1.x `libelle`): the label, a null or blank label removes it.

RemainderDocument.description: A document produced (output) or received (input) by the dissolved step, with the codes of the live steps that use it.

RemainderKind.description: Kind of a remainder element; the stable codes are those of the 1.x contract (`document`, `usage`, `pain_point`).

RemainderSheetView.description:
The read-only sheet of the remainder of the open frame (1.x `RemonteeVue.fiche`), as the viewer may see it (weakness
1.x 5.6-1, `SheetVisibility.ForRemainder`): the facilitator sees the draft, anyone else the latest validated version,
or an empty sheet. Nobody fills it: the dissolved step is gone.

RemainderUsage.description: A document that the dissolved step used, with the code of its live producer.

RemoveBody.description: `POST /api/dissolutions/{id}/remove` (1.x: the same `AffectationDemande`, of which only `genre` and `objet_id` are read).

ResponsibleOrigin.description: Where the person responsible for a sheet comes from: the assignee of the step, or the actor of the lane.

SetRaciBody.description: `PUT /api/steps/{id}/raci` (1.x `RaciDemande`: `couloir_id`, `role`): a null role removes the role of the lane.

ShareFlowBody.description: `PUT /api/flows/{id}/share` (3.0, ADR 085): the share of the cases of an exit, in percent, or null to clear it.

ShareOrigin.description: Where the effective share of a flow comes from (spec 14.3, 3).

SharingGroupLabelBody.description: `PUT /api/projects/{id}/sharing-group-label` (AR-64, route named by the host): the label, or null to remove it.

oneOf.description: The lead time (spec 14.2, S3): it does not count in the completeness of the sheet.

filled_rubrics.description:
Rubrics of the sheet itself that are filled, out of 5: the simple fields that count in the completeness
(bool SheetFieldDefinition.CountsInCompleteness: purpose, tools, frequency, duration; not the actor), and the procedure.

SheetContent.description:
The cleaned content of a sheet. Only the filled fields carry a value; the procedure keeps the order of the
request. Equality compares every field, the procedure line by line and the free text.

SheetFieldBody.description: A simple field of the sheet as entered (1.x `ValeurChamp`: `valeur`, `nombre`): a text or a code, or a number.

SheetPermissions.description: The rights returned with a sheet: validate = fill, clarification and assignment = facilitator.

oneOf.description: The lead time seen by the viewer (spec 14.2, S3), with the frequency and the duration.

SheetSummary.description: The summary of a sheet shown on its step in the map: state, completeness gauge, frequency and duration.

SheetVersionView.description: The latest validated version of a sheet, shown to every member: its number, when and by whom.

SheetView.description:
The sheet of a step (1.x `FicheVue`, `GET /api/etapes/{id}/fiche`): state and completeness as the reader sees them
(`SheetVisibility`), the content (the draft, or the latest validated version), the inputs and outputs of the step
(`DocumentFlows`, visible to every member) with the pain points of their uses, the latest version, the clarification
request, the responsible, the rights (`SheetRights`), the suggestions (only for the one who may fill, A-2.10-42) and,
for the one who sees the draft, the last change and the version to send back in `If-Match`.

volume_quantity.description: The incoming volume of a start step, its quantity (spec 14.2, S1); with VolumePeriod? Step.VolumePeriod, or neither.

oneOf.description: The period of the incoming volume of a start step.

Step.description: A step in a cell (lane, column, row) of its map (annex A 2.4); OriginOperationId replaces the 60 s heuristic (spec 4.6).

StepCellBody.description: The exact cell of a step (1.x `PositionEtape`: `id`, `couloir_id`, `colonne`, `rangee`, row 0 by default).

StepInflow.description: What a flow brings to its target: the cases of its source times its share, null when unknown.

StepMarkersView.description: The markers of a step (1.x `ReperesEtape`): documents produced or received, pain points still open.

StepOutput.description: An output of the step and the uses that other live steps make of it.

StepPlacementBody.description: The cell of arrival of a transferred step (1.x `PositionEtape`: `id`, `couloir_id`, `colonne`, `rangee`).

StepStream.description:
The figures of a step (spec 14.3): its throughput in cases a month and what makes it (entry, inflows, or the gateway
that opens the join), its executions, its work and lead time by execution, its expected lead time (a detailed step:
the one of its detailed map), its work by case, its workload and full-time equivalents. Null is unknown.

StepTranslationsBody.description: `PUT /api/steps/{id}/translations` (new in 2.0): the label by language, a null text deletes the translation.

oneOf.description: The incoming volume of a start step (spec 14.2, S1).

StreamIssue.description: A mention of the completeness check: its code, its gravity and the object it names (spec 14.4).

StreamSeverity.description: The gravity of a mention of the completeness check: a missing or inconsistent value, or a default rule applied.

StreamSubjectView.description:
An object named by the completeness check of the value stream (ADR 085): the readable code and the label of a step or
a lane, in its language of origin, with its map; for a detailed map, those of the step it details, for the root map the
code of the project and the name of the map. Each mention thus names its object, a detailed map included.

StreamTotals.description:
The totals of a map and its detailed maps (spec 14.3): incoming volume, expected lead time, work by case, workload,
rolled %C&A of the main path, lost hours of the open pain points, steps with content and steps quantified.

StructureReply.description:
The reply of every command on a map (1.x `ResultatStructure` without `lot`, `liens_crees`, `liens_coupes`, AR-50):
`id`, `code` and `ids` of the objects created or touched (the client selects the new steps with them), `operation_id`
(what undo will take back; null when the command cannot be undone or changed nothing), `warnings` of the operation,
`structure_version` of the project, the `map` up to date with its layout warnings, and the `history` of the user on it.

TranslatableText.description:
A live text of the project and its current translations: type, identifier, readable code (`A > B` for a flow),
context (map, `map / lane` for a step, `A > B` labels for a flow), language of origin and original text.

TranslationGlossaryBody.description: `PUT /api/projects/{id}/translation-glossary` (ADR 065, route named by the host): the glossary, or null to remove it.

TranslationImportReply.description: The outcome of an import (1.x `ResultatTraductions`: `enregistrees`, `ignorees[ligne, raison]`).

TranslationList.description:
The texts of the workbook (1.x `ListeTraductions`: `projet_id`, `projet_code`, `portee`, `langues`, `textes`): the
project, the scope read, the languages that are the columns of the workbook (annex B 5: the languages of origin of
the texts first, then the chosen targets, each run in the order of the configuration, ADR 083), and the texts to
translate in reading order.

TrashItem.description: A project of the trash (1.x `ProjetCorbeille`): deleted when and by whom, purged for good when.

TrashView.description: The trash as the home page shows it (1.x `CorbeilleVue`): the retention in days and the projects, last deleted first.

headcount.description: The headcount of a lane of people (3.0, ADR 085), or null to clear it.

UpdateLaneBody.description: `PATCH /api/lanes/{id}`: only the fields present change; a null actor removes him.

volume.description: The incoming volume of a start step (3.0, ADR 085), or null to clear it.

UpdateStepBody.description:
`PATCH /api/steps/{id}` (1.x `libelle`, `type`, `etat_automatisation`, `assigne_a`, `couloir_id`, `colonne`, `rangee`):
only the fields present change; a null assignee removes him, a null lane, column or row is CHAMP_OBLIGATOIRE.

days_per_month.description: Working days in a month: the hours of a full-time equivalent divided by the working day.

WorkTime.description:
The work time of a project (S6): the working day, from 1 to 24 hours (7 by default), and the hours of a full-time
equivalent in a month, from 1 to 744 (151.67 by default); both with 2 decimals at most.

WorkTimeBody.description: `PUT /api/projects/{id}/work-time` (3.0, ADR 085): the working day and the hours of a full-time equivalent in a month; an absent value is kept.
